lines.say: This is Pilot-to-Adoption Proof, an independent concept I built for the Deployment Strategist role.
lines.cap: This is Pilot-to-Adoption Proof, an independent concept|I built for the Deployment Strategist role.

lines.say: Every account, person and number in it is synthetic.
lines.cap: Every account, person and number in it is synthetic.

lines.say: A pilot starts with one workflow, two baselines and six acceptance tests.
lines.cap: A pilot starts with one workflow,|two baselines and six acceptance tests.

lines.say: Lead time was never measured, so it stays Unknown, and no improvement is claimed.
lines.cap: Lead time was never measured, so it stays Unknown,|and no improvement is claimed.

lines.say: The fuel surcharge change is walked through a synthetic dependency graph, with each object's depth and owner.
lines.cap: The fuel surcharge change is walked through a synthetic|dependency graph, with each object's depth and owner.

lines.say: If I try to approve now, the server refuses.
lines.cap: If I try to approve now, the server refuses.

lines.say: It lists every blocking gate, and names who recovers each one.
lines.cap: It lists every blocking gate,|and names who recovers each one.

lines.say: The first run fails two of six tests, and each failure names the owner of the object it covers.
lines.cap: The first run fails two of six tests, and each failure|names the owner of the object it covers.

lines.say: Three blockers have no owner, so I give each one a named team.
lines.cap: Three blockers have no owner,|so I give each one a named team.

lines.say: Until every blocker is owned, the gate stays red.
lines.cap: Until every blocker is owned, the gate stays red.

lines.say: Resolving a blocker needs a note.
lines.cap: Resolving a blocker needs a note.

lines.say: The margin report gap is accepted as a risk, with its reason recorded.
lines.cap: The margin report gap is accepted as a risk,|with its reason recorded.

lines.say: Fixing the environment bumps the change to revision three, so the earlier run no longer counts.
lines.cap: Fixing the environment bumps the change to revision three,|so the earlier run no longer counts.

lines.say: A fresh run passes six of six.
lines.cap: A fresh run passes six of six.

lines.say: The approver signs off on this exact revision and run, and all eight gates go green.
lines.cap: The approver signs off on this exact revision and run,|and all eight gates go green.

lines.say: Now I move the simulated clock forward twenty five hours.
lines.cap: Now I move the simulated clock forward 25 hours.

lines.say: The evidence is stale, rollout is blocked again, and the test lead is named to recover it.
lines.cap: The evidence is stale, rollout is blocked again,|and the test lead is named to recover it.

lines.say: A new run and a new approval clear the gate.
lines.cap: A new run and a new approval clear the gate.

lines.say: The rollout is recorded as simulated. Nothing is written to any external system.
lines.cap: The rollout is recorded as simulated.|Nothing is written to any external system.

lines.say: Adoption is shown with its denominator: twenty seven of forty two eligible users.
lines.cap: Adoption is shown with its denominator:|27 of 42 eligible users.

lines.say: Exclusions and unknowns stay out of it, and a warning shows two roles forty four points apart.
lines.cap: Exclusions and unknowns stay out of it, and a warning|shows two roles 44 points apart.

lines.say: A cohort file with bad rows is rejected whole, with each error listed, and nothing changes.
lines.cap: A cohort file with bad rows is rejected whole,|with each error listed, and nothing changes.

lines.say: A verified finding must cite evidence, so this one is refused until I attach the run.
lines.cap: A verified finding must cite evidence,|so this one is refused until I attach the run.

lines.say: The feedback packet keeps verified findings apart from hypotheses, for customer success and product.
lines.cap: The feedback packet keeps verified findings apart|from hypotheses, for customer success and product.

lines.cap: An independent concept by Ayo Ahmed.|Not affiliated with Conduct, and not deployed.
